diagnosis: The account is in eu-central, a region where private networking is not yet supported. Requests for this feature in unsupported regions remain queued indefinitely, which explains the three‑day delay.
reply: Thank you for reaching out. Private networking is currently not available in the eu-central region, so requests made for this region remain in a queued state rather than completing. Once private networking becomes supported in eu-central, the request will be processed. In the meantime, you may consider deploying to a supported region such as eu-west, us-east, or us-west if this feature is required urgently.
